nodes.label: GlutenPlugin
nodes.desc: Registers driver and executor plugins and appends Gluten's session extension.

nodes.label: GlutenSessionExtensions
nodes.desc: Supplies the session extension class name injected into SPARK_SESSION_EXTENSIONS.

nodes.label: GlutenCoreConfig
nodes.desc: Core config entries including the off-heap checks enforced at driver init.

nodes.label: GlutenColumnarRule
nodes.desc: Applies all of Gluten's physical rules in postColumnarTransitions.

nodes.label: BackendsApiManager
nodes.desc: Resolves the active backend name and its iterator, transformer, and metrics APIs.

nodes.label: OffloadSingleNodeRules
nodes.desc: OffloadExchange, OffloadJoin, and OffloadOthers swap Spark operators for transformers.

nodes.label: ExpandFallbackPolicy
nodes.desc: Weighs fallback transitions against native transition cost per plan segment.

nodes.label: FallbackRules
nodes.desc: FallbackOnANSIMode and FallbackMultiCodegens tag plans Gluten must not touch.

nodes.label: FallbackTag
nodes.desc: Tags carried on SparkPlan nodes recording which subtrees must fall back.

nodes.label: PartialFallbackRules
nodes.desc: Velox-specific rule that offloads part of a plan and rows out the rest.

nodes.label: ColumnarToRowExecBase
nodes.desc: C2R transition that converts native columnar batches back to Spark rows.

nodes.label: RowToColumnarExecBase
nodes.desc: R2C transition that feeds vanilla row RDDs into the columnar world.

nodes.label: ColumnarShuffleManager
nodes.desc: Shuffle manager reused from Spark core while exchanging columnar data.

nodes.label: WholeStageTransformer
nodes.desc: Transforms its operator chain into Substrait rels and requests a native iterator.

nodes.label: PlanBuilder
nodes.desc: makePlan glues child rel outputs into one Substrait plan with output names.

nodes.label: RelBuilder
nodes.desc: Builds filter, project, join, and read rel nodes from Spark operators.

nodes.label: ExpressionBuilder
nodes.desc: Maps Spark expressions to Substrait scalar functions, selections, and literals.

nodes.label: VeloxIteratorApi
nodes.desc: genFirstStageIterator wires splits, config, and the serialized plan into the kernel.

nodes.label: VeloxBackend
nodes.desc: Declares backend name and exposes all backend API implementations.

nodes.label: VeloxValidatorApi
nodes.desc: Sends the serialized plan to native validation before offload is accepted.

nodes.label: NativePlanEvaluator
nodes.desc: Static JNI facade calling nativeCreateKernelWithIterator for each stage.

nodes.label: ColumnarBatches
nodes.desc: Load and offload Spark ColumnarBatch instances between JVM and native heaps.

nodes.label: ColumnarBatchJniWrapper
nodes.desc: Native methods exporting batches to Arrow and querying stats.

nodes.label: NativeRowToColumnarJniWrapper
nodes.desc: JNI wrapper that builds native columnar batches from Spark rows.

nodes.label: VeloxColumnarBatches
nodes.desc: Velox-side adapter exposing native RowVectors as ColumnarBatch handles.

nodes.label: IteratorMetricsJniWrapper
nodes.desc: fetch() pulls native output row counts and scan metrics into Spark UI.

nodes.label: VeloxBackend.cc
nodes.desc: Native singleton that initializes Velox memory, cache, and filesystems.

nodes.label: VeloxPlanConverter
nodes.desc: toVeloxPlan translates Substrait rels into facebook::velox PlanNodes.

nodes.label: WholeStageResultIterator
nodes.desc: Executes the Velox plan for one split and streams result batches.

nodes.label: VeloxRuntime
nodes.desc: Per-task native runtime holding the query context and memory pool.

nodes.label: TreeMemoryTarget
nodes.desc: JVM-side hierarchical memory target bound to Spark's off-heap accounting.
